    Crowns of length four and minimality #

    • RayCat.Crown.two_le_n: crowns have length at least four.
    • RayCat.Crown.mk4: the crown (f₀, f₁, f₂, f₃) of length four, with f₀, f₁ and f₂, f₃ peaks and f₁, f₂ and f₃, f₀ valleys; Crown.weight_mk4.
    • RayCat.Crown.weight_shift, Crown.weight_two: the weight is a sum over any period.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.Crown.weight_shift {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (C : Crown P) (k : ℕ) :
    C.weight = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (2 * C.n), depth (C.f (t + k)).snd.snd

    The weight is a sum over any period.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.Crown.weight_two {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] (C : Crown P) (hn : C.n = 2) (k : ℕ) :
    C.weight = depth (C.f k).snd.snd + depth (C.f (k + 1)).snd.snd + depth (C.f (k + 2)).snd.snd + depth (C.f (k + 3)).snd.snd
